name: Cottage pie with lentils
steps: Soften the onion and carrot in a pan with a little oil.
Stir in the cooked lentils and tinned tomatoes and simmer.
Season well and let the mixture thicken for ten minutes.
Boil and mash the potatoes with a knob of butter.
Spread the mash over the lentils and bake at 200C for twenty minutes.
